title: Seeing the Invisible: How Vision-Language Models Read, Predict and Trace Radio Fields
abstract: arXiv:2611.28123v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Operating in the physical world requires reasoning beyond what cameras directly capture. In a city, radio signals are invisible to the lens, yet their strength is governed by the buildings and streets an image does show. Given only these visible structures, can vision-language models (VLMs) infer the invisible radio field they shape? Probing true physical reasoning requires exact fields in real cities, alongside controlled interventions where a single physical factor changes. We build a label-free engine that turns any coordinate on Earth into a ray-traceable city, simulates matched single-factor counterfactuals, and computes every answer exactly. This yields RadioVISTA, a benchmark and training dataset for visual reasoning about invisible fields. Physically, a radio field is the sum of its propagation paths, yet across six continents we uncover a striking field-path dissociation: frontier VLMs accurately judge where a field is strong,

translated_title: 看见无形之物：视觉语言模型如何读取、预测与追踪无线电场
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.28123v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在物理世界中运作需要超越相机直接捕捉范围的推理能力。在城市中，无线电信号对镜头而言是不可见的，但其强度却由图像中可见的建筑物和街道所决定。仅凭这些可见的结构，视觉语言模型（VLM）能否推断出它们所塑造的无形无线电场？要探究真正的物理推理能力，需要真实城市中的精确场数据，以及单一物理因素发生变化的受控干预实验。我们构建了一个无标签引擎，可将地球上任意坐标转换为可进行光线追踪的城市，模拟匹配的单因素反事实场景，并精确计算每个答案。由此产生了 RadioVISTA——一个用于无形场视觉推理的基准与训练数据集。从物理角度看，无线电场是其所有传播路径的总和，然而通过对六大洲的研究，我们揭示了一种显著的“场-路径分离”现象：前沿视觉语言模型能够准确判断场在何处较强，（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该研究提出了 RadioVISTA 基准与训练数据集，通过将地球上任意坐标转换为可光线追踪的城市并精确计算无线电场，系统评估视觉语言模型能否从可见城市结构推理出无形的无线电场，并揭示了模型在“场强判断”与“路径推理”之间的显著分离现象。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RadioVISTA, a benchmark and training dataset that transforms any coordinate on Earth into a ray-traceable city with exactly computed radio fields, revealing a striking field-path dissociation in how frontier vision-language models reason about invisible radio fields from visible urban structures.
